The names are RetroArch playlist names, which follow the No-Intro and Redump
dat names; they are exact, and a system missing from here is simply one
libretro has no artwork for. Every name below was checked against the live
server rather than transcribed from documentation.
switch is deliberately absent: there is no Switch playlist at all, so those
games need SteamGridDB — which is also where Nintendo has had a good deal of
